visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four smartphones are placed in a circle on a white round table. Multiple pairs of hands reach into the frame, tapping screens and scrolling through contact lists under bright, even studio lighting. The background features a blurred white brick wall and a sofa with orange pillows. (2) Three women are visible from a high angle, leaning over the table. They are smiling and looking at their phones with focused eyes. One woman wears a white and black sports top, another a yellow top, and a third a sleeveless floral dress. They hold their phones up to show the screens to the camera, which displays the LINE calling interface. (3) The woman in the white and black sports top stands in a studio setting, laughing as she is presented with a black paper mustache cutout. The lighting is soft and warm. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street at dusk. The same woman walks along a sidewalk, wearing the black paper mustache on her upper lip. She glances at the camera with a shy smile while pedestrians and parked scooters are visible in the background. (5) The woman enters a brightly lit 7-Eleven convenience store. Shelves of snacks and bottled drinks are visible in the background. She stands in front of the glass door, giving a thumbs up and smiling widely with the mustache still attached.

(2) A sharp digital 'tap' SFX occurs as phones are touched. A digital ringing tone follows. (3) A loud vocal outburst from a female speaker exclaiming joy as her call is answered. Overlapping laughter and chatter from other females create a dense acoustic texture. (4) A comic 'boing' SFX triggers a transition. The music continues with a steady electronic beat. (5) A technical 'click' SFX occurs as a mustache prop is mentioned. One female voice becomes dominant, speaking in a teasing, humorous tone. (6) Ambient urban traffic hum and wind noise are introduced as the recording moves outdoors. The main speaker's voice has a slight reverb consistent with an open space. (7) Multiple 'pop' and 'whoosh' transition SFX occur throughout the walk. Laughter from off-camera peers is heard periodically. (8) A 'ding' SFX marks the entrance to the store. The background music swells slightly for the finale, followed by a final cheerful 'Happy Father's Day' greeting from the main speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge -> Conflict -> Resolution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A celebratory Father's Day challenge vlog where creators test whose father responds the slowest to a disconnected call. The loser undergoes a humorous public penalty of wearing a fake mustache while walking to a convenience store, blending entertainment with a holiday theme.
